description: A foot ulcer associated with diabetes, often related to neuropathy and/or vascular disease.
symptoms: Reduced pain may occur when neuropathy is present

appearance.general: A persistent open sore may occur on the foot.

warning_signs: Spreading redness, warmth, pus, fever, black tissue, increasing swelling, or concern for bone infection requires prompt medical evaluation.
prevention: Prompt treatment of cracks or other foot problems.
Optimise diabetes control and avoid smoking.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss sensation, circulation, glucose control, footwear, duration, and any previous ulcers.
